# Problem 1
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
nyc_transit = read_csv("data/NYC_Transit_Subway_Entrance_And_Exit_Data.csv")
nyc_transit = janitor::clean_names(nyc_transit)
nyc_transit = select(nyc_transit,
  line, division, station_name, station_latitude, station_longitude, route1:route11, entry, vending, entrance_type, ada
)

nyc_transit = mutate(nyc_transit, entry = case_match(
  entry, "YES" ~ TRUE,"NO"~ FALSE
  ))

```
